phases.purpose: Build the v010 diagonal/load structure and approach needed before active FR lift.
Actively flex the FR leg until its wheel-bottom clearance increases.
Carry FR through the front plane and establish FR obstacle-top contact.
Change the v010 support geometry so FL can be actively lifted.
Actively lift FL, clear the front plane, and commit the placement posture; top load latches during the immediately continuous P06 wheel advance.
Continue the v010 wheel relation without a hold, latch FL obstacle-top load, and advance until the rear pair nears the edge.
Align the live front/rear geometry to the v010 first-rear entry without leaving the 15 percent envelope.
Load FL and prepare the FR+RL support structure that unloads RR first.
Actively lift RR, clear the front plane, and finish the v010 placement action that establishes RR top load.
Establish the v010 FL+RR-related support/workspace for RL unloading.
Execute the v010 FR-directed load-transfer action before RL lift.
Actively lift RL, clear the front plane, and place RL on the obstacle top.
Advance the whole body past the obstacle, recover the v010 final posture, and stop all wheels.

rear_order_scope.warning: No verified RL_FIRST was found in these cited reports; absence is not a claim that RL_FIRST is invalid or never occurs elsewhere. Initial RL preparation is not RL-first traversal.

fr_knee_conventions.json_absolute_target: servo front_right_knee value is absolute recording/UI command-space deg relative to standing; repeated same value is not another delta
fr_knee_conventions.json_delta: difference of consecutive restored absolute commands; not physical q or UI absolute target
fr_knee_conventions.hard_physical_limits: Existing adapter maps standing/sign to PhysX-safe runtime limits; no USD/limit mutation in this work
fr_knee_conventions.authority_caveat: These are nominal requested intervals, not final native reachability. Same-tick mapper + controller + geometry + requested headroom + final hard/slew determine actual authority. -40deg itself lies inside original hard/reserved limits but may lie outside a particular nominal-relative request domain.

recorded_v010_step12_example.note: Raw recorded adapter fields are kept separate; not silently equated to current frozen mapper schema.

analysis_limits: Read-only offline JSON parsing only; no Recording/FSM/Isaac execution, no optimizer, no live state writes.
Fast planner timing is compiled motion_only schedule, different from manual recorded duration and derived live 120Hz contract timing.
All 9 version source-event mappings returned zero mapping errors; no cross-version trajectory averaging.
Retained targets across source steps are command state, not proof that a physical servo has already reached them. Original explicit wheel-stop events are preserved.
Actual raw snapshot servo deg is physical articulation angle; canonical command vectors and derivative-contract actual vectors have separate semantics.
Source snapshot grounded_reference/robot_ground_diagnostics may be cached spawn data; not used as current contact evidence.
Derived contract contact_class/normal_force fields are historical measurement evidence, not current-v3 hard qualification certification or full 3D contact wrench.
Mass-weighted whole-body CoM, its momentum and tangential reaction cannot be inferred from command values or scalar normal force; these remain MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS.
